title: Backward Arcs in Hamilton Oriented Cycles and Paths in Directed Graphs with Independence Number Two
summary: In a digraph $D=(V,A)$, an oriented path is a sequence $P=x_1x_2\dots x_p$ of distinct vertices such that either $x_ix_{i+1}\in A$ or $x_{i+1}x_{i}\in A$ or both for every $i\in [p-1]$. If $x_ix_{i+1}\in A$ in $P$, then $x_ix_{i+1}$ is a forward arc of $P$; otherwise, $x_{i+1}x_{i}$ is a backward arc. The independence number $α(D)$ is the maximum integer $p$ such that $D$ has a set of $p$ vertices where there is no arc between any pair of vertices.
